annotations.title: Get public-sector pay from a pay table

description:
Look up German public-sector pay from the published pay tables JobJump shows on jobjump.net: collective-agreement tables for public employees and for church, welfare and other public employers, and statutory civil-servant pay (Besoldung) for the federation and every state. Use it when the user names a pay table with a grade (Entgeltgruppe or Besoldungsgruppe) and asks what it pays, how pay rises with the steps, or when they ask which pay table applies to their occupation.

Pass `agreement` and `grade`, and `step` when the user knows it, for the monthly gross table amount, the annual figure, the validity dates, every step of the grade and, where the table defines one, the years between steps. Omit `year` for the table in force today. Pass `occupation` instead to learn which pay tables apply to an occupation and the typical grade, then call again with one of them.

Amounts are gross base pay for full-time work as published in the table; family supplements, allowances and overtime are not included. For take-home pay call calculate_net_salary with the annual gross, and set employment to 'civil_servant' for civil servants. The pay tables are published by the parties to each agreement or set by law; JobJump reproduces them.

agreement.description: Key of the pay table. Municipal employees: 'tvoed-vka'; federal employees: 'tvoed-bund'; social and childcare services: 'tvoed-sue'; nursing in municipal hospitals: 'tvoed-p'; state employees: 'tv-l'; Hesse: 'tv-h'. Civil servants: 'beamte-bund' (federal) or 'beamte-' plus the state code ('beamte-by', 'beamte-nw', 'beamte-br' for Brandenburg). Church, welfare and other public employers have their own keys. Pass either agreement with grade, or occupation.

grade.description: Pay grade as the user wrote it: an Entgeltgruppe such as 'E 13', 'E9a', 'S 8a' or 'P 7', or a Besoldungsgruppe such as 'A 13'. Required with agreement.

occupation.description: Occupation in the user's own words, to find which public-sector pay tables apply to it and the typical grade. Use instead of agreement and grade.

step.description: Official Stufe label (experience step) within the grade, e.g. 3 or '1a'. Omit to get every step of the grade.

year.description: Year of the pay table. Omit for the table in force today; pass a year for an earlier or an announced later table.

name: get_tariff_pay

pay_scheme.description: 'collective_agreement' for employees paid under a collective agreement, 'civil_servant_pay' for statutory civil-servant pay (Besoldung).

typical_grade.description: Grade or grade range JobJump lists as typical for the occupation.

series_id.description: Provenance entry of the occupation-to-pay-table mapping.

as_of.description: Vintage or reference period as published: 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM' or an ISO date.

basis.description: Whether amounts are gross, net, or not a money amount.

dataset.description: Name of the dataset, e.g. 'Entgeltatlas' or 'JobJump salary aggregate'.

estimated.description: True when JobJump modelled or derived the value rather than observing or receiving it.

label.description: Short English name of what this series measures.

license.description: Licence or terms of use that apply to redistributing this series.

methodology_url.description: Public page describing how the series is produced, or null.

population.description: Who or what is counted, e.g. 'full-time employees subject to social insurance'.

sample_size.description: Number of underlying observations where JobJump knows it, otherwise null.

series_id.description: Stable key that series and values in this response refer to.

statistic.description: The statistic these values are. Read this before calling a value a median, a percentile or a maximum.

unit.description: Unit of every value carrying this series_id.

annual_gross.description: Twelve monthly table amounts plus annual_special_payment where JobJump models one; other allowances are not included. Null when no step was given, or when JobJump has no special-payment rate for the table's year (see note).

annual_gross_series_id.description: Provenance entry of annual_gross and annual_special_payment, or null when they are null.

annual_special_payment.description: Annual special payment (Jahressonderzahlung) JobJump models for this grade and year, or null when it models none for the table or has no rate for that year.

calculator_url.description: JobJump net-pay calculator for this table, or null.

grade.description: The grade as the pay table writes it.

grade_url.description: JobJump page for the grade in the current table, or null.

in_force.description: False when the table only applies from a future date, has passed its valid_to date, or has been replaced.

monthly_gross.description: Monthly gross table amount in euros for full-time work at the grade and step, or null when no step was given.

monthly_gross_series_id.description: Provenance entry of the monthly table amounts (monthly_gross and steps).

pay_scheme.description: 'collective_agreement' for employees paid under a collective agreement, 'civil_servant_pay' for statutory civil-servant pay (Besoldung).

step_progression.description: Years spent in one step before moving to the next, where the table defines a progression; null otherwise.

steps.description: Every step of the grade with its monthly gross table amount.

table_url.description: JobJump page showing this pay table.
